title: Product & Business Operations Associate
description:
**PRODUCT & BUSINESS OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE**

**Ahmedabad, Gujarat**

**Full-time | On-site**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

SVECTOR is hiring a Product & Business Operations Associate to work across product, customer, research and business execution.

This role is designed for an early-career technical professional who wants to operate beyond a narrow software-development function and work across technology, product, customers, research and company-building.

You will work closely with the Founder-CEO and relevant functional teams on selected high-priority initiatives across SVECTOR.

This is not an administrative role.

You will be expected to understand problems, structure them, identify what needs to happen, coordinate the relevant people and carry assigned work through to a clear and verified result.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between technical and business problems.

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**

**1. PRODUCT & BUSINESS EXECUTION**

You will take ownership of assigned product and business initiatives.

Typical responsibilities may include:

• Understanding a customer, product or business problem before work begins

• Converting unclear requests into structured problem statements and requirements

• Defining expected outcomes, owners, dependencies and timelines

• Coordinating with Product, Engineering and business teams

• Identifying missing inputs and blockers

• Following work through rather than simply forwarding instructions

• Reviewing whether the delivered result actually solves the original problem

• Maintaining clear records of open issues, decisions and next actions

• Escalating decisions when authority or additional support is required

You should be comfortable taking an objective that is initially ambiguous and turning it into practical execution.

**2. PRODUCT UNDERSTANDING**

Strong product understanding is important for this role.

You may be expected to:

• Use SVECTOR products and understand important workflows

• Understand the intended user and customer problem

• Review customer feedback and product issues

• Distinguish between defects, requirements and new product requests

• Prepare product requirements and acceptance criteria

• Understand APIs, integrations, data flows and technical dependencies

• Follow technical discussions with engineers

• Participate in demos, pilots and implementation discussions

• Verify whether an agreed workflow is actually ready

You do not need to be a full-time software developer.

However, you should have enough technical understanding to work intelligently with engineers and enough business understanding to know why the technical work matters.

**3. RESEARCH & ANALYSIS**

Research will be an important part of the role.

You may investigate:

• Companies

• Customers

• Markets

• Competitors

• Technologies

• Industries

• Product opportunities

• Enterprise accounts

• Candidates

• Market-entry questions

• Commercial models

• Strategic business questions

Good research should clearly distinguish between:

• Verified facts

• Estimates

• Assumptions

• Interpretation

• Missing information

You should be comfortable reading original material, comparing conflicting evidence, checking numbers and explaining the business implication of what you find.

We do not want surface-level summaries.

We want someone who can enter an unfamiliar subject, understand it quickly and produce a useful conclusion.

**4. AI-NATIVE WORK**

This is an AI-native role.

You should already be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or equivalent systems for professional work.

You may use AI for:

• Research

• Document analysis

• Writing

• Data organization

• Summarization

• Workflow automation

• Structured analysis

• Repetitive work

• Product thinking

However, you remain responsible for every output.

You should be able to explain:

• What you asked the system to do

• Which sources were used

• What assumptions were made

• What the model got wrong

• What you corrected

• What remains uncertain

Copying an AI-generated answer without understanding or verifying it is not acceptable.

**5. CUSTOMER & COMMERCIAL WORK**

You may support selected customer and commercial initiatives.

This may include:

• Researching customers and accounts before meetings

• Understanding customer workflows and requirements

• Preparing meeting briefs and talking points

• Drafting customer communication and follow-ups

• Preparing product or commercial material

• Coordinating internal responses to customer questions

• Maintaining customer commitments and next steps

• Supporting demos, pilots and implementation discussions

• Following open issues through to a confirmed outcome

Sending a follow-up is not the outcome.

The expectation is to understand what needs to happen next and keep the work moving until there is a clear result or next state.

**6. HIRING & PEOPLE RESEARCH**

The role may also support selected hiring initiatives.

You may work on:

• Understanding why a role exists

• Preparing role briefs

• Researching candidates

• Reviewing candidate evidence

• Preparing interview material

• Comparing candidates

• Coordinating selected hiring processes

• Maintaining accurate hiring records and next steps

This is not an HR or Talent Acquisition position.

The objective is to support better hiring decisions using structured evidence.

**7. BUSINESS COMMUNICATION & MEETING PREPARATION**

You may prepare:

• Customer briefs

• Internal memos

• Research summaries

• Meeting notes

• Talking points

• Product requirements

• Candidate comparisons

• Proposal content

• Presentation outlines

• Follow-up communication

For important meetings, you may be expected to understand:

• Who is attending

• Prior correspondence

• Relevant documents

• Outstanding questions

• Previous commitments

• Intended meeting outcome

• Required next actions

When the same topic returns later, the relevant context should already be organized and available.

**8. OWNERSHIP STANDARD**

This role is built around ownership.

We do not consider the following to be completed work:

“I sent the message.”

“I followed up.”

“I informed the team.”

“I completed my part.”

The expected operating pattern is:

Understand the result.

Build the plan.

Get the required inputs.

Move the work.

Resolve blockers.

Escalate what genuinely requires a decision.

Check the final result.

Close the loop.

For important assignments, you should always know:

• What outcome is expected

• Who is responsible

• What information is missing

• What dependencies exist

• What deadline applies

• What could block completion

• What remains unresolved

• What decision is required

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are particularly interested in early-career candidates with a strong technical foundation.

Preferred educational backgrounds include:

• Computer Science

• Computer Engineering

• Information Technology

• Software Engineering

• Artificial Intelligence

• Related technical disciplines

Typically, we are looking for candidates with approximately 1 to 5 years of professional experience.

Exceptional recent graduates with strong evidence of ownership, technical ability, product thinking or real-world execution are also encouraged to apply.

Relevant backgrounds may include:

• Product

• Product Operations

• Business Analysis

• Technical Consulting

• Technical Pre-Sales

• Implementation

• Solutions

• Customer Success for technical products

• AI products

• Enterprise software

• Technical project execution

• Early-stage startup roles

**WHAT WE VALUE**

**HIGH OWNERSHIP**

You attempt solutions and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions at every step.

**TECHNICAL FLUENCY**

You can understand software products, APIs, integrations, data flows and implementation constraints.

**PRODUCT THINKING**

You think about the user, customer problem, workflow and outcome, not only the feature.

**RESEARCH DEPTH**

You can independently investigate unfamiliar subjects and reach a reasoned conclusion.

**STRONG WRITING**

Your work should be clear, structured and usable without requiring complete rewriting.

**JUDGMENT**

You understand what you can handle independently and what genuinely requires escalation.

**RELIABILITY**

If you commit to something, it gets done, or the problem is raised before the deadline.

**LEARNING SPEED**

You can enter a new subject, ask precise questions and become useful quickly.

**AI FLUENCY**

You use modern AI tools seriously and understand how to verify their outputs.

**DISCRETION**

You will have access to company, customer, personnel and strategic information. Confidential information must remain confidential and be shared only with authorized people for legitimate company work.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

This is not:

• A personal assistant role

• A calendar-management position

• An administrative support role

• A pure strategy job

• A pure research role

• A pure software-development role

• A conventional project coordinator position

• A role where work ends after forwarding an instruction

Personal errands, household matters and lifestyle management are outside the scope of this position.

**WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Employment: Full-time

Work mode: On-site

The environment is fast-moving and priorities may change as customer, product and company requirements evolve.

You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity while creating structure around the work you own.

Important product, customer or company matters may occasionally require responsiveness outside normal working hours.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

We care more about actual ability than polished interview answers.

The selection process may include:

1. Initial conversation

2. Product or research exercise

3. Business writing / execution exercise

4. Final discussion

AI tools may be used during selected exercises.

Candidates will be expected to explain their reasoning, sources, assumptions, decisions and corrections.

If you are young, technically strong, curious about business, comfortable with AI, capable of learning quickly and want to work across product, customers and execution rather than remain inside one narrow function, we would like to hear from you.

title: Web Development Team Lead
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Web Development Team Lead to manage our web development department and oversee website projects from client onboarding to final delivery.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in WordPress, Shopify, PHP, full-stack development, eCommerce websites, hosting and web applications. They should also be comfortable managing a team, communicating directly with Australian clients, understanding project requirements and ensuring websites are delivered on time with high quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Management**

* Manage and guide the web development team, including developers and designers.
* Assign tasks based on team members' skills, workload and project priorities.
* Monitor productivity, project progress and individual performance.
* Support the team in resolving technical issues and improving development skills.

**2. Project Management and Delivery**

* Manage multiple website projects simultaneously, from onboarding to launch.
* Understand client requirements and convert them into clear tasks for the team.
* Plan project timelines, allocate resources and ensure deadlines are met.
* Monitor project progress, identify delays and take corrective action.
* Ensure websites are properly tested, functional, responsive and ready for launch.
* Maintain project status, planned versus actual launch dates, delays and team workload.

**3. Client Communication**

* Communicate directly with Australian clients to understand their requirements and provide project updates.
* Manage website onboarding, requirement gathering, feedback and revisions.
* Coordinate with clients to resolve issues and clarify technical requirements.
* Manage website handovers after completion, ensuring clients receive the required access and documentation.
* Handle client concerns professionally and escalate major issues when required.

**4. Technical Expertise**

* Lead development projects using WordPress, Shopify, PHP and other relevant web technologies.
* Oversee full-stack development, eCommerce websites, custom functionality and web applications.
* Manage hosting, domains, website migrations, deployments, backups and technical troubleshooting.
* Review website speed, security, responsiveness, functionality and overall performance.
* Guide the team in resolving complex technical issues and preventing recurring errors.

**5. Quality Assurance and Process Improvement**

* Ensure websites are tested before delivery, including functionality, mobile responsiveness, forms, integrations and performance.
* Work with designers, developers, SEO specialists, Paid ads team,  and account managers to ensure smooth project execution.
* Introduce processes and checklists to reduce errors, rework and delivery delays.
* Use AI-based tools and automation where appropriate to improve development speed, code quality and team productivity.
* Maintain clear project documentation, delivery reports and handover records.

**6. Cross-Team Coordination and Internal Communication**

* Work closely with Account Managers to understand client requirements, project scope, priorities and deadlines.
* Coordinate with SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads and Content teams to ensure website requirements are properly understood and implemented.
* Ensure SEO requirements, tracking codes, conversion tracking, landing pages, content updates and other marketing requirements are completed before website launch, wherever applicable.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with all relevant teams regarding project progress, pending tasks, dependencies, changes and delays.
* Proactively follow up with team members and other departments to avoid communication gaps and project delays.
* Ensure all requirements and feedback from clients and internal teams are documented and communicated clearly to the development team.
* Inform Account Managers and relevant stakeholders about project status, technical issues, timeline changes and launch readiness.
* Take ownership of resolving cross-team issues and escalating major blockers when required.
* Ensure a smooth handover between the development team, Account Managers and other relevant teams after website completion.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 7+ years of hands-on web development experience, with at least 2 years in a team lead or similar leadership role.
* Strong practical experience in WordPress and Shopify development.
* Good knowledge of PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, databases, APIs and full-stack development.
* Experience with eCommerce websites, custom web applications, hosting and website deployment.
* Experience managing multiple projects and coordinating a development team.
* Strong client communication and requirement-gathering skills.
* Good written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with Australian clients.
* Strong problem-solving, planning, time management and decision-making skills.
* Experience with website testing, quality control, security and performance optimisation.
* Ability to use AI development tools and automation to improve efficiency and quality.
* Strong internal communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with Account Managers and SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads and Content teams.
* Ability to understand requirements from both technical and digital marketing perspectives and convert them into clear development tasks.
* Strong follow-up, documentation and stakeholder management skills to ensure smooth coordination and timely project delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a digital marketing agency or web development agency.
* Experience handling 20–30+ active client accounts or multiple concurrent website projects.
* Experience working with international clients, particularly Australian clients.
* Experience with project management tools, workflow automation and AI-assisted development.

**What We Expect From This Role**

The person will take ownership of the web development department's day-to-day operations, team performance, client communication, technical quality and project delivery. description:

**Experience: 8\-10 years** 




**Location: AHMEDABAD** 




**Employment Type: Full time / Hybrid** 




**Compensation: Upto Rs. 18 LPA** 




**Immediate Joiners Only** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The Scrum Master is responsible for facilitating Agile delivery across cross\-functional teams, ensuring effective adoption of Scrum principles, Agile practices, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role works closely with Product Owners, stakeholders, and delivery teams to drive predictable sprint execution, remove impediments, improve team performance, and enable successful delivery of business outcomes.

* Remove impediments and proactively manage blockers impacting team productivity.
* Coordinate activities across development, QA, business, and stakeholder groups.
* Monitor sprint progress, team capacity, velocity, and delivery metrics.
* Establish transparent reporting mechanisms and provide regular delivery updates.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and promote a collaborative, high\-performing team environment.
* Drive release planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery readiness activities.
* Promote Agile maturity, knowledge sharing, documentation standards, and process improvements.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong experience in Agile delivery and Scrum framework implementation.
* Expertise in sprint planning, dependency management, and Scrum facilitation.
* Experience managing RAID logs, delivery reporting, and stakeholder communication.
* Strong understanding of Agile metrics, team capacity planning, and delivery tracking.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, coaching, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate across multiple teams and manage competing priorities effectively.

title: Internal Project Coordinator
description:

You'll be the right hand to the Operations Head — managing his calendar, capturing what happens in meetings, and making sure every internal and marketing project moves forward without him having to chase it.
 



 This is not just scheduling and note\-taking. You are the person who knows the status of everything, reminds the right people at the right time, and keeps the operation organized while leadership focuses on growth. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility role — you'll see how a 90\-person company runs from the inside.

title: SENIOR PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
**ABOUT US:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**JOB SUMMARY:**




  





 As a Senior Project Coordinator within our Project Management Office (PMO), you will act as the operational backbone for active satellite manufacturing and mission delivery cycles. Partnering directly with Project Managers and engineering leads, you will drive execution discipline, eliminate cross\-functional bottlenecks, and ensure mission milestones transition seamlessly from CAD models to cleanroom assembly and launch manifests.
 



  





 Your core operational mandate is predictability: maintaining airtight milestone tracking, accelerating internal procurement loops, and ensuring documentation meets rigorous aerospace standards. In this role, your success will be measured by on\-time milestone delivery rates (OTD), schedule variance reduction, and data accuracy across our PMO toolstack.
 



  





  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




  




* **Drive Schedule \& Milestone Integrity:** 
 Partner with Project Managers to maintain comprehensive work\-breakdown structures (WBS), track critical\-path deliverables, and flag schedule variances before they impact integration timelines.
* **Streamline Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Serve as the day\-to\-day liaison between systems engineering, cleanroom manufacturing, quality assurance, procurement, and external launch partners.
* **Lead PMO Governance \& Meeting Cadence:** 
 Own sprint ceremonies, technical review agendas, and cross\-team standups; capture high\-signal minutes of meeting (MoM) and aggressively drive action\-item closure.
* **Maintain Technical Documentation \& Metrics:** 
 Centralize technical baseline documents, flight readiness paperwork, and engineering change requests (ECRs) while building real\-time status dashboards for executive review.
* **Proactive Risk \& Blocker Resolution:** 
 Surface manufacturing delays, component lead\-time anomalies, and integration risks early; run root\-cause follow\-ups to implement mitigation strategies.
* **Coordinate Technical Procurement \& Logistics:** 
 Expedite technical purchase requisitions (PR/PO workflows) for mission\-critical parts and coordinate precision logistics for aerospace\-grade hardware and testing campaigns.



  





  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR ?**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics, or similar) or Business Administration/Operations Management.
* 1–2 years of hands\-on project coordination or PMO experience in a fast\-paced, engineering\- or manufacturing\-driven environment.
* Working proficiency with industry\-standard project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Project, Asana, or ClickUp).
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with a track record of managing multiple competing deadlines without dropping operational details.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, comfortable interfacing with senior engineering specialists and external vendors.



  





  





**NICE\-TO\-HAVES:**




  




* Prior exposure to the Space, Aerospace, Defense, or Precision Hardware Manufacturing sectors.
* Foundational understanding of satellite subsystems, avionics, payload integration, or cleanroom manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with hardware product lifecycle stages (PDR, CDR, TRR, and flight integration).



  





  





**WHY JOIN US ?**




  




* **Front\-Row Seat to the NewSpace Revolution:** 
 Work on physical flight hardware destined for orbit from India’s first commercial satellite mass\-production hub.
* **Accelerated Career Trajectory:** 
 Receive hands\-on mentorship from veteran aerospace program managers, developing deep domain expertise across space mission lifecycles.
* **High\-Impact, Zero\-Red\-Tape Culture:** 
 Experience the speed of a high\-growth tech disruptor paired with the manufacturing infrastructure of an aerospace leader.
* **Collaborative Ecosystem:** 
 Join an ambitious, multidisciplinary team of space enthusiasts, engineers, and builders dedicated to making space accessible globally.
